t: This is a bust of Ernest Bevin, made by the sculptor Ernest Shone-Jones after a work by Edwin Whitney-Smith. Bevin was a trade union leader and Labour politician. He co-founded the Transport and General Workers' Union and served as its General Secretary from 1922 to 1940. In the wartime coalition government he was Minister of Labour and National Service, where he succeeded in maximising the labour supply for the armed services and for industry, with a minimum of strikes and disruption. The bust commemorates him and shows his likeness.
